source.author: verg
source.text: Sic animis iuvenum furor additus: inde, lupi ceu raptores atra in nebula, quos improba ventris exegit caecos rabies, catulique relicti faucibus exspectant siccis, per tela, per hostis vadimus haud dubiam in mortem, mediaeque tenemus urbis iter; nox atra cava circumvolat umbra.
source.text_original: Sic animis iuvenum furor additus: inde, lupi ceu / raptores atra in nebula, quos improba ventris / exegit caecos rabies, catulique relicti / faucibus exspectant siccis, per tela, per hostis / vadimus haud dubiam in mortem, mediaeque tenemus / urbis iter; nox atra cava circumvolat umbra.
source.text_english: So the youths’ minds were thus fired with fury: then, like ravening wolves in a dark mist, whom cruel hunger has driven blind, and whose abandoned whelps wait with parched throats, we go through spears, through enemies, on a path to death with no doubt, and we hold our way through the middle of the city; black night circles around with hollow shadow.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: audent igitur homines inprobissimi iustitiae facere mentionem, qui feras immanitate uincunt, qui placidissimum dei gregem uastant lupi ceu raptores atra in nebula, quos inproba uentris exegit caecos rabies .
reuse.text_original: audent igitur homines inprobissimi iustitiae facere mentionem, qui feras immanitate uincunt, qui placidissimum dei gregem uastant lupi ceu raptores atra in nebula, quos inproba uentris exegit caecos rabies .
reuse.text_english: So these utterly wicked men dare to make mention of justice, men who surpass wild beasts in savagery, who devastate the most peaceful flock of God like ravening wolves in the dark cloud, men whom shameless greed has driven forth, blind with frenzy.
